title: Light, osmotic stress, and fungicides affect hulled creosotebush mericarp germination
why: The USDA Woody Plant Seed Manual page on Larrea (opened) cites this paper, with Barbour 1968, for 'conditions conducive to germination include darkness' in creosotebush (Larrea tridentata). The title names light as a tested factor of L. tridentata germination, which would close sense_light_nonvisual. Its abstract did not turn up in four searches and no DOI was found; the seed manual is only the pointer.

title: Volatile organic compound emissions from Larrea tridentata (creosotebush)
why: Branch emissions of volatiles from field creosotebush with a strong diurnal pattern (abstract opened). The page does not say whether branches were enclosed on the living plant or cut, and the paper is an emission inventory; if the methods show living branches and a stimulus response or signalling role it closes sense_chemical, otherwise it is out under the owner's reading.
